what: FINDING_6 / A1b cover OOS checkpoint (~L1067) but not Exit 0 OOS re-entry (~L1049)
scenario_or_breakage: On the python path, Exit 0 still tells the orchestrator to re-invoke `ship-pr.sh --resume-phase pr-create` after a successful OOS checkpoint; `ship.py` has no `--resume-phase` flag, so a run that follows the Exit 0 bullet can argparse-fail with INTERNAL_ERROR even when L1067 is fixed
suggested_fix: Extend A1b with an Exit 0 (~L1049) python inline override (re-invoke the python fence without `--resume-phase`, same as FINDING_6); add a structural pin in `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh` that greps the Exit 0 bullet, not only the OOS checkpoint section
